# oncall_schedule_layer (Resource)

Manages a rotation layer within an oncall_schedule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "oncall_team_members" "platform" {
  team_id = data.oncall_team.platform.id
}

resource "oncall_schedule_layer" "primary" {
  schedule_id     = oncall_schedule.primary.id
  name            = "Weekly rotation"
  tier            = 1
  rotation_length = "P1W"
  start_at        = "2026-01-05T09:00:00Z"
  handoff_at      = "2026-01-05T09:00:00Z"

  # Block order is the rotation order.
  member {
    user_id = data.oncall_team_members.platform.members[0].user_id
  }
  member {
    user_id = data.oncall_team_members.platform.members[1].user_id
  }

  # No day_of_week means every day.
  restriction {
    start_time = "09:00"
    end_time   = "17:00"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `handoff_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of the first handoff.
- `name` (String) Layer name.
- `rotation_length` (String) ISO 8601 duration (e.g. "P1W" for one week). All components must be >= 0 with at least one > 0.
- `schedule_id` (String) Schedule this layer belongs to. The API has no move-between-schedules operation.
- `start_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp the rotation begins.
- `tier` (Number) Escalation tier. Cannot be changed after creation.

### Optional

- `end_at` (String) RFC3339 timestamp the rotation ends. Omit for no end.
- `member` (Block List) One rotation member. Block order is the rotation order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--member))
- `restriction` (Block List) One time-of-day/day-of-week restriction window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--restriction))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Layer UUID.

<a id="nestedblock--member"></a>
### Nested Schema for `member`

Required:

- `user_id` (String) Member's user UUID.

Read-Only:

- `user_name` (String) Member's display name (not the email, which is PII-redacted for non-admins).


<a id="nestedblock--restriction"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restriction`

Required:

- `end_time` (String) "HH:MM" in the schedule's timezone.
- `start_time` (String) "HH:MM" in the schedule's timezone.

Optional:

- `day_of_week` (Number) 0=Sun..6=Sat. Omit for every day.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import oncall_schedule_layer.primary <layer-uuid>
```
